title: Percona: live PXC + ProxySQL status
description: Runs `nexus status percona`: the 3 Galera PXC nodes (ProxySQL writer=primary, others=replica) + 2 ProxySQL routers + the writer leader.

observe.what: exactly 1 pxc-node role=primary (the ProxySQL writer, hostgroup 10 ONLINE) + 2 replica (backup_writer) + 2 proxysql role=router; leader=<writer>

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.GetStatusAsync reads wsrep state from each PXC node + the ProxySQL hostgroup assignment (ONLINE-only) to derive writer vs replica.
